```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
    // Tile counts for a full BLK×BLK block
    int tiles   = BLK / DIM;        // tiles per block (I or J dimension)
    int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;   // tiles along K

    // Scratchpad layout (fixed for all blocks since BLK is constant):
    //   A at bottom: tiles * tiles_K * DIM rows
    //   B at top:    tiles * tiles_K * DIM rows (placed at top, growing downward)
    uint32_t a_base    = 0;
    uint32_t b_base    = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
    int      SPAD_DEST = 128;

    // Flush once at the start
    gemmini_flush(0);

    // Outer loop: j0 (column blocks) — B tiles are loaded ONCE per j0
    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
        int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
        if (ncols <= 0) continue;
        if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
        int pad_j = BLK - ncols;

        // --- Stage B scale factors for this j0 (once, reused across all i0) ---
        for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
            memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);

        // --- Configure and MVIN B tiles ONCE for this j0 block ---
        // B_in layout: B_in[k*DIM][j0*BLK + j*DIM], row stride = MATMUL_N
        gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                    1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
        gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
        for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
                gemmini_extended_mvin(
                    (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                    b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM,
                    DIM, DIM);

        // Inner loop: i0 (row blocks) — reuse B tiles already in scratchpad
        for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
            int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
            if (mrows <= 0) continue;
            if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
            int pad_i = BLK - mrows;

            // Stage A scale factors for this (i0, j0) pair
            for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
                memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);

            // Programming model sequence start: config_ex first
            gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                        1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

            // Load scales: A (sel=0) then B (sel=1)
            gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
            gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

            // MVIN A tiles only (B tiles already in scratchpad from outer j0 load)
            gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
            for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
                for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
                    gemmini_extended_mvin(
                        (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                        a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM,
                        DIM, DIM);

            // Configure output stride and requantizer
            gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
            gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                         tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                                         0, 0, 1);

            // Fused compute: A and B already in scratchpad; skip_mask=0x38
            gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                                 pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                                 a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0,
                                 SPAD_DEST,
                                 false, false,
                                 false, false, false,
                                 NO_ACTIVATION,
                                 0, 0,
                                 false,
                                 0x38);

            // Bulk drain: single read_smem call for all mrows at once
            gemmini_mx_read_smem(
                &C_hw[i0 * BLK][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
                SPAD_DEST * 16,
                mrows * ncols);
            gemmini_fence();
        }
    }
}
```
